integrity: The all-dimensional common-neighbor formula is proved from orthogonal-complement dimension and endpoint exclusion. The rank-three edge and triangle counts are then derived symbolically; finite computations serve only as reproducibility checks.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite fields and the standard nondegenerate dot product. Projectivized rank-three orthogonality is closely related to classical polarity graphs, so terminology mismatch in finite-geometry literature remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact edge-triangle profile of finite-field total dot product graphs
